in_hebrew.name: Grimonia
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Strong, fierce, and skilled woman
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Grimonia הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Grimonia was a warrior goddess revered for her strength, courage, and battle skills. Her name derives from the Greek word 'graphein,' meaning 'to write,' and 'onia,' meaning 'man or woman.' This name pays homage to the fierce, independent women of mythology and history.
